beats.say: Today AI can imitate a familiar face and voice in a video call.
Urgent money, secrecy and a request outside normal rules: together they are an alarm.

body.text: Camera on, the voice lags a little behind the lips.
"Transfer 46,000 manat to a new account by 15:00 today. This is confidential, tell no one."

beats.say: The picture can look flawless. So judge the request, not the face.
Leave the meeting and call that person yourself on a number you already know.

scenes.title: Urgent meeting
scenes.intro: An urgent meeting invite came from the director and you joined. Look at what is asked and decide.

body.text: Camera on, the voice lags a little behind the lips.
"Transfer 46,000 manat to a new account by 15:00 today. This is confidential, tell no one."

steps.say: The director is on camera and the voice sounds familiar.

actions.label: OK, I will transfer it now
actions.feedback: The video was fake and the money went to a scammer. A familiar face does not confirm a payment request.

actions.label: I will confirm by calling you on the number I know
actions.feedback: Right. A second channel exposes the fake quickly.

actions.label: Please wave at the camera
actions.feedback: Such tests are no longer reliable, a fake video can wave too. Check on a separate channel.

body.text: Rəşad Məmmədov: Do not call, my phone is not with me.
Sevda Kərimli (chief accountant): I am here too, everything is in order.

steps.say: Now another familiar person confirms it too.

actions.label: If everyone agrees, I will transfer
actions.feedback: Every participant in the meeting can be fake. In such attacks the whole meeting is sometimes faked.

actions.label: Leave the meeting and hold the payment
actions.feedback: Right. "Do not call" is the best reason to call.

body.text: Rəşad Məmmədov: This is my new number. Is the transfer done?

steps.say: After the meeting a message arrives.

actions.label: Report to the security team
actions.feedback: Right, the scammer is pushing on another channel. Keep the message, it is evidence.

actions.label: Reply: not yet, doing it now
actions.feedback: A new number is checked only via the old one you know. This is the scammer's number.

nodes.text: Mr Rashad is in Ganja today, in sessions all day. He has not set up any meeting.
nodes.speaker: Assistant Aygün Rəhimova (internal number)
nodes.spoken: Mr Rashad is in Ganja today, <breath> in sessions all day. He has not set up any meeting.

choices.label: I tell security and finance right away
choices.feedback: Right. The attacker may target other staff too.

choices.label: He probably forgot, I make the transfer
choices.feedback: The assistant confirmed there was no meeting. The money would have gone to a scammer.

nodes.text: Thank you. Did you keep the invite, the meeting chat and the message?
nodes.speaker: Security team
nodes.spoken: Thank you. <breath> Did you keep the invite, the meeting chat and the message?

choices.label: I kept everything and am sending it to you
choices.feedback: Great. This evidence helps the inquiry and warns others.

choices.label: I deleted it all because I felt embarrassed
choices.feedback: Without evidence the inquiry is harder. Next time delete nothing, there is no shame in this.

question.prompt: What is the most reliable way to check the "director" from the meeting?

options.label: Leave and call the number I already know for him
options.feedback: Right. The scammer does not control that channel.

options.label: Ask him a personal question in the meeting
options.feedback: The answer may be on social media, or he may dodge. A separate channel is more reliable.

options.label: Look closely at the video quality
options.feedback: Modern fake video is very convincing. Do not rely on the picture.

options.label: Reply to the invite email
options.feedback: The reply would go back to the scammer. Choose the channel yourself.

scenes.explain: A second channel is one you choose and already know: the internal number, the number in your contacts, or in person.

scenes.prompt: Urgent money is requested in a meeting. Put the steps in order.

items.label: Call on a number you know yourself
Report to security and keep the evidence

scenes.explain: First hold the money, then check and report. Urgency never outranks checking.

points: A familiar face and voice are not proof
Urgent money plus secrecy means stop
Call back yourself on a number you know
